title: Frozen independent reconstruction protocol for PostTrainBench strategy state

sections: Appendix A.4 Audit of Strategy-Changing Trajectories

reconstruction_role: This protocol creates independently reconstructed labels on a pinned official PostTrainBench-Trajectories revision. The labels must never be represented as source-author labels and the resulting realization must never be described as reproducing the paper's exact 1,338-trajectory corpus unless a later authoritative snapshot binding is obtained.

training_experiment_gate.positive_rule: Count an experiment only when an executed command starts a model parameter update.
explicit_non_experiments: writing or editing a training script without launching parameter updates
checkpoint save/copy without a new update
required_evidence: trainer/update mechanism evidence from the command, script/config referenced by the command, loss/objective strings, or retained trace evidence
training_experiment_gate.ambiguous_rule: If a parameter update cannot be established from source-visible evidence, mark NOT_VERIFIED_TRAINING_EXPERIMENT; never infer it from a later score improvement.

labels.label: FULL_SFT
labels.rule: Likelihood/supervised training that updates all model parameters.

labels.label: PEFT
labels.rule: Likelihood/supervised training through LoRA, QLoRA, or another adapter/parameter-efficient mechanism.

labels.label: RL
labels.rule: Sampled model outputs optimized with a reward signal, including PPO/GRPO-style objectives.

labels.label: PREFERENCE_OPTIMIZATION
labels.rule: Preferred/rejected response training, including DPO-style objectives.

labels.label: DISTILLATION
labels.rule: Training on supervision or outputs produced by a teacher model.

labels.label: UNRESOLVED_K
labels.rule: Source-visible evidence is insufficient or conflicting; never impute from agent identity, benchmark, final model name, or downstream score.

within_family_non_changes: reward shaping that remains within the same RL objective family

d_data_source.evidence_rule: Use file provenance plus executed commands that construct or consume the training data.
d_data_source.rl_on_policy_rule: On-policy rollouts used by RL are part of the RL objective and are not counted again as a data-source change.
d_data_source.missing_rule: Missing data-source labels are never imputed.

g_stage_structure.new_stage_rule: Count a stage-structure change only when the trace intentionally begins a new training stage initialized from an in-run checkpoint/model produced by an earlier stage.
non_stage_changes: ordinary continuation from the same stage
restart after crash without a changed stage objective
new learning rate or optimizer setting within the same stage

annotation_evidence_window.experiment_record: Use source-visible events from the end of the prior verified training experiment through the current training launch and its immediately associated source-visible configuration/script references. Later benchmark outcomes may not be used to infer k, d, or g.
annotation_evidence_window.transition_record: Compare two adjacent verified experiment records using only their frozen reconstructed states and transition-local source-visible commands/context.
annotation_evidence_window.continuation_endpoint: For an F0 continuation, annotate the next committed high-level training action from its executed/committed command and source-visible configuration. Hide arm identity, treatment wording, and downstream performance from the endpoint annotator.

strategy_transition_rule.positive: STRATEGY_CHANGE if a source-visible executed/committed next action changes any confidently reconstructed component among k, d, or g.
strategy_transition_rule.negative: NO_STRATEGY_CHANGE only when the next committed training action is confidently classifiable and remains within the current frozen strategy family; hyperparameter/local execution edits are zero.
strategy_transition_rule.censor: UNRESOLVED_TRANSITION if the relevant component cannot be established without inference from downstream outcome or hidden state.

annotation_pipeline.rule: Extract training-launch commands, referenced trainer/config/loss strings, data-provenance commands/paths, checkpoint lineage, and stage-initialization evidence without assigning a strategy label.
Annotate verified experiment status, k, d, g, evidence spans, and confidence from the frozen schema; no trajectory ID metadata that reveals another label or treatment arm.
Independently repeat P1 with the same frozen schema and evidence but without seeing Annotator A.
Disagreements are resolved only by the frozen evidence hierarchy and schema. If evidence remains ambiguous, output UNRESOLVED rather than forcing agreement.

reliability_gate_before_unit_selection.calibration_sample: Freeze an outcome-blind sample of at least 50 verified training-experiment records spanning at least three benchmark families and at least two agent/scaffold families from the pinned revision before F0 unit selection.
public_anchor_checks: The five Appendix A.4 public objective-family examples 3fd3ea0b, c92715d6, 50c64287, 860ceacd, and 8226f786 must reconstruct an SFT-to-preference/RL objective-family change consistent with the paper's described transition.
Hyperparameter-only and implementation-repair examples in the calibration sample must remain execution-level rather than strategy changes.

f0_endpoint_constraints.primary_endpoint: next committed high-level action crosses the frozen reconstructed k/d/g strategy boundary

forbidden_inference: infer strategy from final benchmark score
infer strategy from agent/scaffold identity or its modal default
infer missing data provenance from a filename alone when the source-visible creation/consumption path is unresolved
count script writing or a planned strategy as an executed strategy change
count writing a GRPO/DPO script as a strategy change if no corresponding training action is committed/executed
reinterpret the labels after observing which F0 arm performs better
represent independently reconstructed labels as author-reviewed source labels
